steps.text: Install the bearing cap and shell on the connecting rod with the numbers on the cap and the rod adjacent to each other. On the 3/8" -24 bolts (In-line and “V” engines), tighten the nuts to 40-45 lb-ft torque. Tighten the nuts on the 5/16" -24 bolts (early 6V engines) to 24-28 lb-ft torque. NOTE: Rework of an old 6V-53 rod assembly to utilize 3/8" bolts is not recommended. IMPORTANT: The new 6V-53 rod assembly with 3/8" bolts should be used for replacement at the ume of normal overhaul.
